title: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.16319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. translated_title: HyWe：为真实世界混合网页任务统一搜索与操作
translated_abstract: 真实世界的混合网页任务既需要信息收集，也需要页面交互，然而基于搜索的智能体与基于操作的智能体却是分别开发和评估的。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了HyWe，这是一个在单一模型和单一轨迹中统一这两种能力的框架。其两种模式使用专用的提示词和工具集来维持子目标的执行；通过显式切换来选择所需的能力，并且共享的历史记录使每种模式能够在另一种模式的发现基础上继续工作。为了提供这些行为的示范，我们开发了HyWeCollector，这是一个完全自动化的流水线，它利用任务原型、四种切换模式和多智能体合成来生成经过验证的混合轨迹。我们在这些示范数据上训练了HyWe-35B，以在单个35B网页智能体中统一高效的信息收集与浏览器交互。为了评估混合任务的完成情况，我们引入了HyWeBench：包含100个由人工编写的任务，这些任务所在的网站与训练网站不同……
tldr: 该论文提出HyWe框架，将搜索与页面操作两种能力统一到单一模型和轨迹中，并通过全自动数据生成流水线HyWeCollector与评测基准HyWeBench，训练出能够在真实网页任务中同时高效完成信息收集和浏览器交互的HyWe-35B智能体。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HyWe, a framework that unifies search and operation capabilities within a single model and trajectory, and leverages an automatic data pipeline (HyWeCollector) and a new benchmark (HyWeBench) to train HyWe-35B, a web agent that efficiently handles both information gathering and browser interaction for real-world hybrid web tasks.
